* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 1 February 2025<ref name="img-V0-L-angerfearaggression_ai">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/angerfearaggression_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e6e58df2da8bc676256fd425703a4c22d9dff6e8 commit e6e58df] (1 February 2025); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/angerfearaggression_ai.gif.</ref>.
